zh.title: 長榮航空12月1日起開航桃園至印度德里直飛航線
zh.summary: 長榮航空宣布將於12月1日起正式開航桃園－印度德里直飛航線，該航線即日起開放旅客訂位購票。根據長榮航空說明，開闢桃園至印度德里直飛服務，主要目的在於拓展南亞市場，並藉此串聯北美航網。
body: 長榮航空正式宣布，規劃自12月1日起開航桃園至印度德里之直飛航線。對於有訂位需求之旅客，相關班機的訂位與購票服務已自即日起公開開放辦理。
長榮航空表示，開闢桃園－印度德里直飛航線，主要目的在於拓展南亞市場。透過提供直飛航班服務，進一步促進台灣桃園與印度德里之間的空中客運聯繫。
長榮航空同時指出，新開航的德里航線不僅能深化南亞市場的營運佈局，同時亦可有效串聯其北美航網，提供更為便捷的跨洲航網連接服務。

en.title: EVA Air to Launch Nonstop Taoyuan-Delhi Route on Dec 1
en.summary: Taiwanese carrier EVA Air has officially announced that it will launch direct flights between Taoyuan and Delhi, India, beginning December 1. Reservations and ticket sales for the new nonstop service have been opened to the public starting today. According to statements from EVA Air, opening the direct air connection between Taoyuan and Delhi is designed to expand the airline's presence in the South Asian market, while also linking and strengthening its broader North American route network.
body: EVA Air has announced that it will launch a new nonstop service between Taoyuan and Delhi, India, starting December 1. Reservations and ticket sales for flights on the new route are open to passengers starting today.
According to EVA Air, the launch of the direct Taoyuan-Delhi route is primarily intended to expand the airline's market presence in South Asia.

Furthermore, the carrier highlighted that establishing flights to Delhi will allow it to effectively link its South Asian offerings with its existing North American route network, facilitating seamless intercontinental air connections for passengers.
